name: Torva Grimtusk
summary: Level 7 half-orc Berserker barbarian — reckless front-line damage and a mountain of hit points.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 1d12 + 4 slashing damage (**+2 while Raging** — add it to the total). *Extra Attack:* Torva makes **two** attacks with this action. *Brutal Critical:* on a crit, roll one extra weapon die.

actions.name: Handaxe (Thrown)
actions.description: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 1d6 + 4 slashing damage (+2 while Raging). *Extra Attack:* two throws.

actions.name: Rage
actions.description: *Bonus Action (4 per Long Rest, lasts 1 minute):* Advantage on Strength checks and saves, **+2 melee damage** with Strength weapons, and **resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing** damage.

actions.name: Frenzy (while Raging)
actions.description: *Bonus Action on each turn of a Frenzied Rage:* one extra Greataxe attack (+2 Rage damage applies). Torva gains one level of Exhaustion when the rage ends.

actions.name: Reckless Attack
actions.description: *When making her first attack on her turn:* attack rolls using Strength have **Advantage** this turn, but attack rolls against her have Advantage until her next turn.

traits.name: Feral Instinct
traits.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls, and she can act normally on the first turn even when surprised if she enters her Rage first.

traits.name: Danger Sense
traits.description: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects she can see (traps, spells) while not Blinded, Deafened, or Incapacitated.

traits.name: Fast Movement
traits.description: Speed increased by 10 ft (already included) while not wearing heavy armor.

traits.name: Mindless Rage
traits.description: She can't be Charmed or Frightened while Raging.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: Once per Long Rest, when reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, she drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.description: On a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one additional weapon damage die.
